operations.title: Nima closes the five-site occurrence Kummer-character audit
operations.body: Event 1240 completes Entry 1217's generic character falsifier. For every complementary occurrence pair, ∂A=∂A^c, so all five deck-flipped radical terms cancel in q_A-q_Ac. K_occ, its 2X_A first-Rees symbols, Koszul maps, and dX_A conormals are C2^5-trivial. Hence K_occ⊗Q[C2^5] has each existing character with multiplicity 240 (48 regular C5 modules) and generates zero new characters.
